name: EveryInfra
description: Query public data from Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Taobao, JD, TikTok, Amazon and many more platforms, plus web search and multi-source fact checks.
description_zh: 查询小红书、抖音、淘宝、京东、TikTok、亚马逊等平台的公开数据，并支持网页检索与多来源核实。用你的 EveryInfra API Key 连接，按次计费，失败不扣费。
description_en: Query public data from Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Taobao, JD, TikTok, Amazon and many more platforms, plus web search and multi-source fact checks. Connect with your EveryInfra API key; pay per call, no charge on failure.
examples_zh: 搜索小红书上关于露营装备的热门笔记，整理前 20 条的标题、点赞数和链接
看看抖音和微博现在的热榜都有什么
对比淘宝和京东上便携咖啡机的价格区间和销量靠前的店铺
核实一下：欧盟人工智能法案对通用模型的义务从哪天开始适用？给出原始出处
把这几个 TikTok 视频下的评论导出成 CSV
examples_en: Find the most-liked Xiaohongshu notes about camping gear and list the top 20 titles, likes and links
Show me what is trending on Douyin and Weibo right now
Compare price ranges and top-selling shops for portable coffee makers on Taobao and JD
Verify when the EU AI Act obligations for general-purpose models start to apply, with primary sources
Export the comments under these TikTok videos to CSV
